title: A Murder Forewarned — Part 1
summary: A man is found bludgeoned to death on a water taxi. The mystery points to only one person but there is no evidence because the other suspects cleaned up the crime scene. The episode ends on a cliffhanger where the main suspect is found murdered after a heated argument and Neville is the suspect.
method: The killer put up the same picture on the wall at the victim's house and held a lecture there right after he killed the man. A friend of the victim's wife found the body and decided to clean the crime scene and move the body because he thought the wife was responsible.
killer: A local professor, who used to be a criminologist
